items.signal_prefix: Customers announced 10+ new fab projects just this quarter

set.signal: Customers announced 10+ new fab projects just this quarter; leading-edge logic and DRAM fabs running at FULL capacity. Largest customers giving rolling 8-quarter forecasts, longer-lead-time POs with cancellation/expedite charges, and some conversations extending to 2030; CFO: 'I think it will be the availability of clean room at a high level that will determine what we can all ship next year.' Applied hiring to have capacity to DOUBLE quarterly system output from current levels by 2028 (+1,500 manufacturing/AGS hires this quarter; new Singapore manufacturing center officially opened; planning the next manufacturing capacity expansion to have the option to support further increases in demand by 2030). Record operating cash flow >$3B, FCF $2.3B.

items.reason: The CFO's 'I think' / 'next year' hedge was lost; the 2030 date is the demand horizon of the planned expansion, not the expansion date.
items.evidence: We are also planning our next manufacturing capacity expansion, ensuring we have the option to support further increases in demand by 2030.
